details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 1; an explicit trait, not a bonus calculated from Size.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Dark sight 6 squares; ordinary hearing.

**Tactics and retreat:** Burn the nearest participant in the feud and make close pursuit unpleasant. It loses a useful battlefield when the rivals cooperate.

**Encounter and conversation:** It is feeding on a feud and loses its audience when the rivals stop answering each insult.

**Habitat:** Broken shrine; summoned court; place of conflict · **Communication:** Common

**Loot:** Recoverable possessions or lair clues chosen for the adventure; body parts grant no automatic special equipment or coin value.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.

## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-ash-demon


**Category:** Fiend · **Role:** Burning striker · **CV:** 33

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ash-laden claws | Reason | 1 Boon | 3 fire damage. | 6 fire damage. Burning 1. | 9 fire damage. Burning 2. |

Use the attributes above for defenses named by incoming attacks. Same targeting, limits and costs apply; no opposed second roll.

### CV worksheet

**Reference damage:** 3/6/9

**Reference type:** fire

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.45

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.3 → 1.45: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.15. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=4.000, O=6.894. Uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/encounters.md). Utility is provisional and does not simulate control, positioning or summon choices.

**Ability sources:** [elemental burn](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/elemental-burn.md), [Heated Hide](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/heated-hide.md), [scatter embers](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/scatter-embers.md).

**Coverage reference:** [Pathfinder family survey](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/family-survey.md); original HOL prose and mechanics.

# Elemental Burn

*Heat crawls along the strike, or frost flowers across the skin where it passes.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-elemental-burn


**Action:** Main Action

Use the printed attack. Standard also applies the printed Burning 1 or Freezing 1; Strong applies that condition at 2. The creature card chooses one condition, not either at use. Burning is fire damage; Freezing is cold damage. Lightning attacks may explicitly leave Burning.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.

[Creature procedure](../bestiary/procedure.md) · [Monster ability index](README.md)
